title: 对话与独白质量差，令人反感
description: 游戏中的对话和独白内容无聊、冗长、重复、不连贯，部分带有厌女或种族主义言论，整体质量低下，影响玩家体验。
evidence: you're stuck listening to the really boring thoughts of some guy you don't care about at all
the "story" is just the dull ramblings of a frustrated loner
les dialogues ne sont pas très intéressants

evidence_items.quote: the main character keeps on yammering about all his mundane problems the entire time
evidence_items.description: 主角全程不停抱怨琐事
evidence_items.quote_zh: 主角一直在喋喋不休地讲他所有那些平凡的问题

evidence_items.quote: Half of the game is spent listening to him whine, rather misogynistically, about his struggle to get laid, as he chases 20-year-old Japanese girls, who he openly admits to having nothing in common with.
evidence_items.description: 主角对追求日本年轻女性的抱怨带有厌女色彩
evidence_items.quote_zh: 游戏有一半时间都在听他相当厌女地抱怨自己难以搞上床，因为他追求20岁的日本女孩，而他自己也公开承认和她们毫无共同之处。

evidence_items.quote: The dialogue is WAY too flowery. The poetry and, what I can only call pretense, in his voice seems forced.
evidence_items.description: 对白过于华丽做作，不自然
evidence_items.quote_zh: 对话太过华丽了。他声音中的诗意，以及我只能称之为矫揉造作的东西，显得很勉强。

evidence_items.quote: les dialogues ne sont pas très intéressants
An endless sour monologue about solitude and about how getting old makes it hard to shag 20 year old japanese girls
evidence_items.description: 关于孤独和年龄的酸涩独白
evidence_items.quote_zh: 一段没完没了的酸溜溜的独白，关于孤独，以及关于变老如何让人难以操20岁的日本女孩

evidence_items.quote: the main character occasionally jars the relatability with a racist comment
evidence_items.description: 主角偶尔会说出种族主义言论，破坏角色的亲切感。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 主角偶尔会用一句种族主义言论打破这种共鸣感

evidence_items.quote: The main characters thoughts were a stream of misogynistic teen boy drivel
evidence_items.description: 对话内容充满厌女青少年式的胡言乱语
evidence_items.quote_zh: 主角的想法就是一串厌女的青春期男生胡扯

evidence_items.quote: you're stuck listening to the really boring thoughts of some guy you don't care about at all
evidence_items.description: 被迫听一个不关心的人的无聊独白
evidence_items.quote_zh: 你被困在那里，听着一个你根本不在乎的家伙那些极其无聊的想法

evidence_items.quote: Long ass diologue of this ♥♥♥♥♥ talking
evidence_items.quote_zh: 这混蛋长篇大论的对话

evidence_items.description: 独白内容令人烦躁且不连贯
evidence_items.quote_zh: 一段烦人的、支离破碎的独白

evidence_items.quote: narration is average and the story/dialogues is really bad
evidence_items.quote_zh: 叙述很一般，故事/对话真的很糟糕

evidence_items.quote: the "story" is just the dull ramblings of a frustrated loner
evidence_items.description: 故事只是令人乏味的独白
evidence_items.quote_zh: 所谓的“故事”不过是一个失意孤独者乏味的絮叨

evidence_items.quote: Often the things he says barely relates to the object
evidence_items.description: 角色对话内容与所选物品几乎无关
evidence_items.quote_zh: 他说的那些话往往和那个物品几乎没什么关系
